answers.reason: The research associate holds no office and has no specified seat in the central university senate.
The budget planning round is a high-level central round for university leadership and deans, not for research associates without office.
The research associate holds no office and no seat is described for them in the appointment committee.
The research associate does not hold an office or an elected representative seat in the faculty council.
Without an office or an explicit seat, the research associate is not permitted to sit on the formal study commission.
The examination board is a formal body for higher-ranking office holders and examination administrators, not research associates.
Awarding faculty research grants is a decision for higher-ranking faculty members and leadership rather than doctoral research associates.
As a working group rewriting course module descriptions, it is open to teaching staff such as the research associate.
Choosing equipment for a teaching laboratory is a practical task in which teaching and research staff like the research associate may participate.
Planning the orientation week is a low-level organizational round open to faculty members assisting in teaching.
